prompts.neutral: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: an individual production game sprite for the educational astronomy mobile app Mission Cosmos, ages 6–12. Create an ORIGINAL friendly small hovering robot guide, sophisticated playful science design, not a baby toy and not a known franchise character. Character design locked: large rounded-square pearl-white head shell with a broad rounded midnight-navy face visor; two turquoise oval LED eyes and a small simple turquoise smile within the visor; small round gold side pivots at both temples, no antenna; compact pearl-white rounded trapezoid torso with a navy chest inset carrying ONE simple small gold four-point star emblem, no letters; navy flexible shoulder joints, TWO short pearl-white arms ending in turquoise three-digit mitten hands; lower body is a simple navy rounded hovering base with a narrow turquoise horizontal ring, NO LEGS, NO FEET, NO flame. Head width about 1.25 times torso width. Exactly two arms and two eyes. Palette pearl #F5F7FB, midnight #152238, turquoise #3DB8C5 / #7ED6DF, warm gold #F4C95F. Art direction: crisp polished 2D/2.5D game character illustration, simple broad shapes, restrained soft dimensional shading, clean antialiased silhouette, friendly readable expressive eyes, consistent gentle light from upper left, moderate detail, readable at 96px. Camera straight-on front view, full character visible, fixed proportions. Individual sprite only, genuinely transparent RGBA background, no floor or cast shadow, no background glow, no scenery, no decorative floating objects, no text, no speech balloon, no border, no watermark. Square 1024x1024 canvas, robot head centered horizontally around y=300, hovering base around y=810, leave generous transparent margins for raised arms. The character's body should occupy about 65–70% of canvas height. POSE: neutral attentive idle, head upright, both arms relaxed slightly away from torso, palms inward, open friendly oval eyes and a small calm smile. ONE character, ONE pose.
